crossRefs.note: It may be that Yahweh will look on the wrong done to me, and that Yahweh will repay me good for the cursing of me…
If the household is worthy, let your peace come on it, but if it isn’t worthy, let your peace return to you.
Then they also who are fallen asleep in Christ have perished.

translations.web: for you will heap coals of fire on his head, and Yahweh will reward you.
translations.bsb: For in so doing, you will heap burning coals on his head, and the LORD will reward you.
translations.kjv: For thou shalt heap coals of fire upon his head, and the LORD shall reward
translations.asv: For thou wilt heap coals of fire upon his head, And Jehovah will reward thee.
